Scholarship Opportunities | Office of Global Scholarships Go Global: Scholarship Opportunities Beyond Stanford The Office of Global Scholarships (OGS) advises current Stanford students and recent alumni on scholarship opportunities outside the U.S., not for study at Stanford. View an Index of Scholarship Opportunities Scholarship Opportunities Main content start OGS Searchable Database : Explore and sort the many global scholarships available to Stanford students, post-docs, and recent alumni. Filter by location, opportunity type, eligibility requirements, application deadlines, and more. Note: If you are a student looking for information on admission and scholarships to study at Stanford, contact the Undergraduate Admissions Office , Stanford's Graduate Admissions and/or the Financial Aid Office . Stanford complies with all federal non-discrimination laws. View an Index of Scholarship Opportunities >>> Having trouble viewing a scholarship? Download a CSV file instead. Additional Resources If you are an undergraduate student looking for information on admission and scholarships to study at Stanford, contact the Undergraduate Admissions Office and/or the Financial Aid Office . For international students, visit the international applications page . If you are a graduate student, contact Stanford University's Graduate Admissions and/or the Financial Aid Office.
